Sandbox_WayMoreCars: More Car Features + Spawn Zones Expansion
Sandbox_GamestaSpawnRate_tooltip: Base chance to spawn a vehicle in a zone. Default is -1 (uses vanilla by default). Spawn rate is slightly influenced by the vanilla Vehicle Spawn Rate setting.
Sandbox_GamestaSpawnRateModifiedTrafficJ: Spawn Rate (%) for Modified Traffic Jams
Base chance to spawn a vehicle in traffic jam zones. Default is -1 (uses default of 100%). Spawn rate is slightly influenced by the vanilla Vehicle Spawn Rate setting.
Sandbox_GamestaVehicleCorpseDistribution: Controls how often corpses spawn in vehicles (default is 'Normal' or ~8% per seat).
Sandbox_GamestaClimbVehicles_tooltip: Whether or not the player can climb vehicles (true = you can climb cars).
Sandbox_GamestaNoGoodCars_tooltip: Whether cars have a chance to spawn in good condition regardless of other vehicle settings. Random 'Good' vehicles is a VANILLA feature, this removes them (true = removes randomly generated good condition, 'Good' vehicles).
Sandbox_GamestaInteractBombVehicle: Car Bombs / Car Alarms / Fire / Cars Jump / And More
Sandbox_GamestaInteractBombVehicle_toolt: Whether explosive devices (and fire) can interact with vehicles (true = explosives/fire interact with vehicles).
Sandbox_GamestaAutoVehicleFuelPumps_tool: A new system that allows for leaving the fuel pump nozzle in your car to pump gasoline at the vanilla rate of 1 liter per real life second (true = uses this new hands-free system).
Sandbox_GamestaRandomAngle_tooltip: Whether cars spawn facing in random directions (true = scattered cars).
Sandbox_GamestaWeatherEffects_tooltip: Whether the weather outside can affect players in vehicles; from breaking your windshield and having a hard time seeing to getting rained on with your window down (true = extra weather effects are enabled).
Sandbox_GamestaTrafficJamsLV: Extra Traffic Jams Spawning in LV
Sandbox_GamestaTrafficJamsLV_tooltip: Whether new traffic jams spawn in Louisville (true = more traffic jams).
Sandbox_GamestaTrafficJamsExtra: Extra Traffic Jams Spawning outside LV
Sandbox_GamestaTrafficJamsExtra_tooltip: Whether new traffic jams spawn outside Louisville (true = more traffic jams).
Sandbox_GamestaSpawnRateBurnt: Spawn Rate (%) to Modify ALL Vehicles into Burnt Vehicles
Sandbox_GamestaSpawnRateBurnt_tooltip: Base chance to spawn a burnt vehicle in a zone. Default is -1 (uses vanilla by default). Spawn rate is slightly influenced by the vanilla Vehicle Spawn Rate setting.
Sandbox_GamestaBaseVehicleQuality_toolti: Controls how good condition vehicle parts are. -0.1 = disabled, 1.0 = perfect (higher for guaranteed), lower = worse.
Sandbox_GamestaChanceToPartDamage_toolti: Chance that spawned vehicle parts are damaged. -1 means disabled, 100% means every part is always damaged.
